data.body: Landed as gerrit change 2277 (Change-Id I909a81fe). Guardrail rationale captured here rather than in the description to preserve the signed plan-review attestation: the probe's run_python tool executes arbitrary Python in-process. It is scoped to a workflow_dispatch-only diagnostic against a throwaway ephemeral Jira DC with no other secrets in the job; REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1 keeps rebar's own ticket store read-only; it is inert on every ordinary run (opt-in behind REBAR_DC_RICHTEXT_PROBE=1) and never runs on push/PR/schedule. This mirrors the existing scripts/jira_dc_capability_map.py precedent. Awaiting LLM-Review + Verified before submit; ticket stays in_progress until landed.
